name: sih26104-cdk
description: SIH26104 Voice Integrity Control Plane — infrastructure. Five dependency-ordered stacks plus one standalone CostSafetyStack.
//: VERSION TRAP: `aws-cdk-lib` (the construct library, 2.266.x) and `aws-cdk` (the CLI, 2.1138.x) are SEPARATE version streams. They both start with `2.` and look like they should match — they must not. Pinning the CLI to a library version yields `npm error notarget No matching version found for aws-cdk@2.266.0`. The library is pinned exactly because a minor bump can change synthesised output; the CLI is pinned exactly so CI and a laptop produce the same template.

scripts.synth:check-zero: cdk synth ComputeStack --context deployRuntime=false --json | node -e "const s=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const r=Object.entries(s.Resources||{});const bad=r.filter(([,v])=>(v.Type==='AWS::ECS::Service'&&v.Properties?.DesiredCount!==0)||(v.Type==='AWS::AutoScaling::AutoScalingGroup'&&!(v.Properties?.MinSize==='0'&&v.Properties?.MaxSize==='0'&&v.Properties?.DesiredCapacity==='0')));if(bad.length){console.error('RUNTIME NOT ZERO:',bad.map(([k])=>k).join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('runtime-zero OK: '+r.length+' resources checked')"
